_help: corrections_form_url: the link to your Google Form (Send > link icon). The footer's 'Spot an error?' link appears on every page once this is filled in. corrections_page_field (optional): to have the form fill in the page the visitor came from, open the form's ⋮ menu > Get pre-filled link, type anything into the 'Page' question, click Get link, and copy the number after 'entry.' (for example 123456789). vercel_analytics: set to true after turning on Web Analytics in Vercel (Project > Analytics > Enable). It adds Vercel's visitor counter to every page; it uses no cookies. It only runs on Vercel, not in local builds.
